about: The three sealed exams, as run. Each plan was written down and dated before its sealed regions were downloaded; each region was used once. Numbers are copied from the generated result files named in 'source' (do not edit by hand there either).

exams.title: Exam 1
exams.model: Model A: a shrinkage ratio per 0.25° cell (hotspots)
exams.lesson: On regions it had never seen, one simple ratio per region beat it, and the NOAA-20 handover agreed only 69%. We published the failure, found the two causes (a double count, and NOAA-20 not calibrated to Suomi NPP) and fixed them for exam 2.

exams.title: Exam 2
exams.model: Model A2 with NOAA-20 calibrated to Suomi NPP (hotspots view)
exams.lesson: All five tests passed on four new regions on three continents. This model runs the hotspots view.

exams.title: Exam 3
exams.model: Model D-a: fire-power-class ratios in burning days (the default view)
exams.lesson: The tournament winner, out of nine candidates, sat the third exam once, on four more unseen regions, and passed all five tests. This model runs the default burning-days view.

cell.name: Accuracy, square by square
cell.plain: Error for each 0.25° square and month, against real MODIS counts in 2020–2021. Lower is better. Exam 1 required beating one simple ratio per region; exams 2 and 3 allowed at most 1 point worse than it.

coverage.name: Honest ranges
coverage.plain: How often the real value falls inside our 80% range. About 80% means the ranges are neither too narrow nor too wide.

total.name: No inflation
total.plain: Predicted total ÷ real total over all regions. 1.00 is perfect.

national.name: Accuracy for the whole region
national.plain: Error of each region's monthly total (lower is better).

swap.name: Satellite handover
swap.plain: When Suomi NPP is swapped for NOAA-20, how often the two estimates agree within their ranges.
